about.bio:
Hello, I'm Annie Rose, a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant and digital creator. I'm a Juris Doctor graduate with experience in administrative support, documentation, records management and bookkeeping assistance, plus legal research and documentation work.

I'm currently in Intermediate Virtual Assistant training at The VA Bar, and I run my own digital products shop, Jjang Digitals by Rose. I enjoy organizing information, preparing and reviewing documents, and keeping things accurate and easy to follow. I'm adaptable and always happy to learn new systems.
